metaTitle: Custom Frosted Awards Recognition | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom frosted awards recognition for your team. Perfect for annual events. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Frosted awards offer a sophisticated, etched-glass look that diffuses light beautifully, making engraved text and logos stand out with a soft, elegant glow. Unlike clear crystal, the frosted finish hides fingerprints and minor scratches, keeping your recognition pieces looking pristine on office shelves. Popular shapes like the Optical Globe, Music Notes Award, and Iceberg Summit Award take on a refined, modern appearance when frosted. Ideal for annual banquets, safety milestones, or sales achievements, these awards pair well with deep-tone base colors for a striking contrast.
heroAltText: Custom frosted awards recognition featuring a frosted glass Optical Globe award on a wooden base
